card.name: Needle and syringe size specifications
card.fires_on: Words and spaces just before or inside needle and syringe specifications, such as gauge, length, or syringe volume, in injection or infusion instructions.

modes.label: Needle gauge and length

modes.description: The space or article before a syringe volume or needle size in an intradermal test.

modes.label: Other administration details
modes.description: Spaces or small words before numbers in infusion set or administration steps.
